intro: Between 2026-04-13 and 2026-09-30, ZCyberNews catalogued 18 articles tagged apt, every one of them rated high severity. GopherWhisper, CHOSEN BRICK, and CyberAv3ngers appear among the most-covered threat actors in this set. The reporting spans government, energy, cryptocurrency, financial services, and technology, with incidents recorded across the United kingdom, United states, Global, Japan, and Mongolia. The collection below gathers that coverage in one place.
